node: AI optical networking components and photonics supply chain
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for AI optical networking and photonics. The strongest direct exposures in this pass are optical transceiver/component vendors, advanced laser/InP device suppliers, optical contract manufacturing, and early-stage optical-engine platforms. This is not a recommendation list; it is a Layer 1B research universe. The two-lane funnel keeps Lumentum as a reference product leader while prioritizing less obvious or more narrowly exposed names such as Applied Optoelectronics, Fabrinet, and POET Technologies for follow-up evidence checks.
